BODY — Front Door

15. REMOVE DOOR BELT MOULDING
(See pages BO-19 and 20)
Remove the two screws and moulding.

BD1721

16. REMOVE TWO DOOR GLASS STOPPERS
17. REMOVE TWO DOOR TRIM SUPPORTS
18. REMOVE INNER STABILIZER

BD1724

19. REMOVE DOOR GLASS
(a) Remove the two glass channel mounting nuts.

BD1735

(b) Remove the door glass by pulling it upward.

BD1736

20. REMOVE WINDOW REGULATOR
(a) Disconnect the connector from the motor.
(b) Remove the equalizer arm bracket mounting bolts.
(c) Remove the regulator mounting bolts.
(d) Remove the regulator through the service hole.
